title: SOLICITATION NOTICE- Massena NY Virtual Law Enforcement Training Facility- Construction
description: Solicitation: Construction Services Contract for Massena Virtual Law Enforcement Training Facility- Construction project at the Massena LPOE, Rooseveltown, NY. Proposals are due Saturday, November 21st, 2026 by 5:00 pm EST. All proposals should be sent electronically via email to kyle.cole@gsa.gov. The on-site visit will be held on Thursday, October 15th at 10am EST. All individuals who would like to attend must email kyle.cole@gsa.gov at least one day prior to the site visit to confirm their attendance. The site visit is not mandatory, but is encouraged. Questions are due via email to kyle.cole@gsa.gov by close of business on Friday, October 30th, 2026. In order to receive the Specifications and Drawings for this solicitation, you must complete Attachment 10, "Safeguarding and Dissemination of Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) Building Information." The completed CUI Form must be sent via email to kyle.cole@gsa.gov. Reference is made to the PRE-SOLICITATION NOTICE Notice ID EQPXCAC-26-0011. All solicitation posts and updates for the Massena Virtual Law Enforcement Training Facility- Construction project will be posted to Solicitation No. 47PC5326R0029. Massena Virtual Law Enforcement Training Facility- Construction project at the Massena LPOE, Rooseveltown, NY includes, but is not limited to providing all labor, materials, tools, management, and full time on-site supervision required by contract documents to construct a Virtual Law Enforcement Training Facility. The contract work incorporates site demolition/excavation/grading/planting/paving, general construction, electrical, mechanical, plumbing, hard-wall partitions, security, and telecommunication work to meet United States Customs and Border Protection (CBP) requirements as follows: 1) Selective demolition of Architectural, Mechanical and Electrical systems, construction, and finishes at nearby Building G to support the renovation work. 2) Mechanical, plumbing, electrical, communication, security, and fire suppression systems to serve the uses of the new facility. 3) Earthwork, exterior improvements, and utilities for new facility. 4) Installation of common floor, wall, and ceiling finishes. 5) Installation of specialty floor, wall, and ceiling finishes as required. The contractor shall expect to interface with the GSA Authority Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) for all major Life Safety contract submittal reviews and approvals. Typically, all submittals, once completed, will be grouped and transmitted to the AHJ for review and final approval. The contractor shall expect to interface with the US Customs and Border Protection agency representatives at the Land Port of Entry for all major submittal reviews and approvals as well as coordination for the installation of supporting equipment and devices with the facility. Exact work description will be identified and indicated in the Contract Documents. Products to be used will be specified within the drawings and individual Specification Sections. The contractor shall comply with the projects design specifications and drawings. The work will be constructed under a single prime contractor who is to adhere to all security requirements and guidelines for building access. The awardee will be required to complete the security clearance process. The procurement will be solicited and awarded to one (1) Total Small Business set-aside contractor. Offers from other than small business concerns will not be considered by the agency. The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code associated with this procurement is 236220, Commercial and Institutional Building Construction. The Small Business Administration standard of 45 million dollars in annual receipts averaged over the last three (3) completed fiscal years. This project shall be performed by an experienced Contractor that has performed similar work. The estimated performance period is 340 calendar days after Notice to Proceed has been issued. The magnitude of construction for this project is between $1,000,000 and $5,000,000. The procurement method that will be implemented for this project will be in accordance with FAR Part 15.1-Source Selection Processes and Techniques. This project is a competitive acquisition utilizing the Lowest Price Technically Acceptable (LPTA) selection process. The government will evaluate technical responses using three evaluation factors to determine the proposal that best meets the requirements of the government. The vendor's experience, past performance, and staffing plan are acceptable/unacceptable factors. If a vendor does not meet the criteria for the prior experience factor, or the past performance, and receive an unacceptable, it will receive no further consideration under this acquisition. The vendor�s prior experience, past performance and staffing plan/structural organization factors, are equal in importance. All the technical evaluation factors, when combined, are significantly more important than price. This Contract will be awarded to a vendor whose proposal provides the lowest price with technically acceptable criteria to meet the government�s needs. The planned project delivery method will result in a Firm-Fixed-Price contract for construction services. Performance and payment bonds will be required following award pursuant to the Miller Act. A bid guarantee is also required. A description of GSA�s policies and procedures, in addition to that outlined in FAR 43.204, that apply to definitization of equitable adjustments for change orders under construction contracts can be found at GSAM 552.243-71 Equitable Adjustments, https://www.acquisition.gov/gsam/552.243-71. Interested firms must be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM), in order to receive a contract award. Firms can register via the Internet site at https://www.sam.gov or by contacting SAM Service Desk at https://www.fsd.gov. The solicitation and associated information will only be available from the https://sam.gov website mentioned above. No telephone requests will be accepted. The solicitation will not be a sealed bid and there will not be a formal bid opening. All inquiries must be in writing, via email to the person(s) specified in the solicitation. All answers will be provided in writing and will be available on the aforementioned https://sam.gov posting. Offeror's will not be reimbursed for proposal submittal expenses. Several solicitation documents will be posted as "Locked" packages in the https://sam.gov posting. In order to view or download the packages, vendors must have a secure account. Information on how to register for an account and log in is available on the https://sam.gov website, under the "Getting Started" tab. Interested parties are strongly encouraged to register to this notice to receive notification of actions including posting of any amendments. However, offerors are advised to check the site frequently as they are responsible for obtaining amendments. buyer: Junta de Gobierno del Ayuntamiento de Carmona
title: Spain – Construction work – Obras para la ejecución del complejo de la música y el patrimonio en los antiguos mataderos de Carmona y la adecuación de sus entornos.
description: El objeto del contrato consiste en la ejecución de una actuación integral, unitaria y coordinada para la creación del Complejo de la Música y Rehabilitación del Matadero Viejo para Almacén Arqueológico y adecuación del entorno urbano y ordenación de las zonas de aparcamiento de la ladera existente entre el Alcázar Puerta de Sevilla y los edificios del Nuevo y Viejo Matadero, mediante una solución urbana, arquitectónica y constructiva conjunta que comprende la construcción de la Nueva Escuela de Música sobre el solar del Nuevo Matadero de Carmona según Pliego Técnico del concurso, mediante jurado, para la redacción de proyectos, a nivel de anteproyecto, para la construcción del complejo cultural para la música y el patrimonio en los antiguos mataderos de Carmona y la adecuación de sus entornos urbanos; la rehabilitación del Matadero Viejo para su uso como Almacén Arqueológico, conforme al programa de necesidades descrito en el Pliego Técnico del Concurso de Ideas; y la adecuación e integración del entorno urbano, incluida la ordenación de las zonas de aparcamiento de la ladera existente entre el Alcázar Puerta de Sevilla y los edificios del Nuevo y Viejo Matadero, reforzando el atractivo paisajístico de la ruta «Washington Irving» de entrada a Carmona y eliminando el actual impacto visual y medioambiental del aparcamiento existente en las márgenes de la carretera A-380.

title: Switzerland – Market and economic research; polling and statistics – BKS-2319 Durchführung der Erhebung zu Familien und Generationen 2028 und der Erhebung zur Sprache, Religion und Kultur 2029.
description: L'Office fédéral de la statistique (OFS) souhaite faire appel à un institut de sondage, dans le cadre d’une procédure ouverte d'appel d'offres, dans le but de réaliser des enquêtes par sondage sur les familles et les générations (EFG) 2028 ainsi que sur la langue, la religion et la culture (ELRC) 2029. Le mandat comprend notamment l'implémentation des questionnaires en ligne, la gestion des adresses ainsi que l'envoi, la réalisation des enquêtes pilotes et principales, y compris la gestion d'une hotline. L’OFS recherche un prestataire capable de fournir les prestations requises et disposant des compétences techniques et spécialisées nécessaires.

title: Germany – Natural gas – Gaslieferung 2028-2030
description: Gegenstand der Vergabe ist die Gaslieferung an alle Gasabnahmestellen des Auftraggebers, die im Verzeichnis der Abnahmestellen aufgelistet sind. Das Gesamtliefervolumen beträgt im Lieferjahr 2028 bis 2030: je ca. 20,0 Mio. kWh. Die Ausschreibung der Gaslieferung an die in der Leistungsbeschreibung aufgeführten Abnahmestellen erfolgt für den Zeitraum vom 01.01.2028 bis zum 31.12.2030. Der Gasliefervertrag endet spätestens zum 31. Dezember 2030, ohne dass es einer Kündigung bedarf.

title: Netherlands – Construction work – Groot onderhoud en functionele verbetering Parkeergarage De Barones te Breda
description: Procedure Aanbesteding middels de Europees openbare procedure conform hoofdstuk 2 van het ARW 2016. Opdrachtgever De opdrachtgever bij deze aanbesteding is de Gemeente Breda. Voor meer informatie over de Gemeente Breda verwijzen wij u naar de website van de gemeente: www.breda.nl. Projectomschrijving Parkeergarage De Barones, gelegen aan de westflank van het historische stadscentrum van Breda, biedt plaats aan circa 510 voertuigen en behoort tot de drukst bezette gemeentelijke parkeergarages. Door de centrale ligging vervult de parkeergarage een belangrijke functie voor bezoekers van de binnenstad, werknemers en uitgaanspubliek. Vanuit het Meerjarenonderhoudsprogramma (MJOP) staan de komende jaren diverse omvangrijke onderhoudswerkzaamheden gepland. Gelet op de aard en omvang van deze werkzaamheden, in combinatie met de wens om de parkeergarage functioneel te moderniseren en beter aan te laten sluiten op de huidige gebruikersbehoeften en stedelijke ontwikkelingen, heeft de gemeente ervoor gekozen deze werkzaamheden integraal uit te vragen. De opdracht omvat zowel de verdere uitwerking van het beschikbare Definitief Ontwerp (DO) tot een Uitvoeringsgereed Ontwerp als de realisatie van de werkzaamheden. Globale scope van de werkzaamheden A. Bouwkundige werkzaamheden Onderhoudswerkzaamheden: -Vloercoatings; -Plafonds; -Schilderwerk; -Vervangen van deuren; -Vervangen van gevelpuien; -Renovatie van toiletvoorzieningen. Functionele verbetering entree Tolbrugstraat: -Aanpassing van de gevel; -Optimalisatie van de indeling; -Vernieuwing van vloerafwerking; -Vernieuwing van plafonds; -Schilderwerk; -Vernieuwing van balustrades. B. Installatietechnische werkzaamheden Werktuigbouwkundige installaties: -Vervangen van stuwventilatoren; -Vervangen van afzuigventilatoren; -Vernieuwing van regeltechnische installaties ten behoeve van ventilatie; -Vernieuwing van CO- en LPG-detectiesystemen. Elektrotechnische installaties: -Vervangen en aanpassen van licht- en krachtinstallaties; -Vervangen van schakel- en verdeelinrichtingen; -Vernieuwen van verlichting, noodverlichting en vluchtwegaanduiding; -Vervangen van het noodstroomaggregaat; -Vernieuwen van brandmeld- en ontruimingsinstallaties. Uitvoering De werkzaamheden worden gefaseerd uitgevoerd, zodat de parkeergarage gedurende de uitvoering zoveel mogelijk beschikbaar kan blijven voor bezoekers en gebruikers. Planning (indicatief) - Uitwerking ontwerp, engineering en bouwvoorbereiding: januari – februari 2027; - Realisatie werkzaamheden: maart – eind juli 2027; - Onderhoudstermijn 1 jaar: eind juli 2027 - eind juli 2028. Percelen Deze opdracht is niet verdeeld in percelen. Doel Het doel van deze aanbesteding is om voor de realisatie van het werk een overeenkomst te sluiten met één aannemer. Mercell Deze aanbesteding zal uitsluitend en geheel digitaal online worden afgehandeld via het Mercell platform (www.mercell.com). Een uitgebreide instructie met betrekking tot digitaal aanbesteden treft u aan in de Vragenlijsten.

title: Netherlands – Cleaning and sanitation services – Schoonmaakdiensten gemeente Laarbeek
description: De doelstelling van de opdracht is het zorgen voor een hygiënische en schone werkomgeving in het kantoorpand van de gemeente waarbij de medewerkers zo min mogelijk last hebben van de werkzaamheden. Verder vindt de gemeente het van belang dat mensen met een afstand tot de arbeidsmarkt en arbeidsgehandicapten participeren in het arbeidsproces. Op grond van artikel 2.82 van de Aanbestedingswet 2012 is deelname aan deze aanbestedingsprocedure voorbehouden aan sociale werkplaatsen, ondernemingen met als hoofddoel de maatschappelijke en professionele integratie van gehandicapten of kansarmen, of programma’s voor beschermde arbeid. Voorwaarde is dat ten minste 30% van de werknemers binnen de betreffende sociale werkplaats, onderneming of het programma bestaat uit gehandicapte of kansarme werknemers. De gemeente Laarbeek streeft naar een hygiënische, zichtbaar schone, gezonde en prettige (werk)omgeving voor alle werknemers, bezoekers en gebruikers van het gemeentehuis. Dit dient te worden gerealiseerd met minimale overlast door schoonmaakwerkzaamheden, zodat de dagelijkse activiteiten ongestoord kunnen plaatsvinden. Om die doelstelling te bereiken zal de gemeente met één dienstverlener de overeenkomst aangaan. De overeenkomst wordt aangegaan voor een periode van twee (2) jaar en zeven (7) maanden met de mogelijkheid om twee (2) maal te verlengen met telkens één (1) jaar. De ingangsdatum van de overeenkomst is 1 juni 2027.

title: Netherlands – Computer-related equipment – EA Hardware
description: CVO Rotterdam is voornemens één opdrachtnemer te contracteren voor de levering van gebruikers- en professionele ICT-hardware ten behoeve van haar scholen en organisatieonderdelen. De opdracht omvat onder meer de levering van laptops, desktops, servers, storage, netwerkapparatuur, randapparatuur en aanverwante producten, alsmede optionele dienstverlening zoals installatie, gebruiksklaar opleveren, aanvullende garantie en gecertificeerde afvoer van hardware. Met deze aanbesteding beoogt CVO een leverancier te selecteren die de gevraagde hardware tijdig, kwalitatief goed en tegen marktconforme voorwaarden kan leveren. Daarnaast hecht CVO waarde aan een betrouwbare samenwerking, passende ondersteuning, korte levertijden en een doelmatige uitvoering met een zo laag mogelijke beheerslast. Een belangrijk doel van deze aanbesteding is het beperken van de milieu-impact van de inkoop van hardware en het bevorderen van verantwoorde ketens. CVO verwacht dat inschrijvers aandacht hebben voor onder meer energieverbruik, levensduur, repareerbaarheid, herinzet, verpakkingsmaterialen en verantwoorde verwerking aan het einde van de gebruiksfase. Daarnaast verwacht CVO dat fundamentele arbeids- en mensenrechten in de productieketen worden gerespecteerd. Waar passend sluit CVO aan bij de door het Rijk geformuleerde uitgangspunten voor maatschappelijk verantwoord opdrachtgeven en inkopen. De historische uitgaven aan hardware bedroegen circa € 1.294.000 inclusief btw in 2024 en circa € 2.448.000 inclusief btw in 2025. Aan deze bedragen kunnen geen rechten worden ontleend en CVO verstrekt geen afnamegarantie. De overeenkomst treedt naar verwachting in werking op 1 januari 2027 en heeft een initiële looptijd tot en met 31 december 2029. CVO heeft de mogelijkheid de overeenkomst eenzijdig te verlengen met maximaal drie maal één jaar onder gelijkblijvende voorwaarden.

title: Netherlands – Software package and information systems – AvePoint Control Suite Plus for M365 and Power Platform TAM Silver (1)
description: Universiteit Maastricht (UM) is voornemens een overeenkomst te sluiten voor de levering van circa 15.400 licenties AvePoint Control Suite Plus for Microsoft 365 and Power Platform, inclusief de bijbehorende licentiegerelateerde dienstverlening. UM maakt momenteel reeds gebruik van oplossingen van AvePoint binnen haar Microsoft 365- en Power Platform-omgeving. Deze oplossingen zijn geïntegreerd in de bestaande technische en functionele omgeving van UM en maken onderdeel uit van de bestaande beheerprocessen en werkwijzen. Voor deze aanbesteding heeft UM er bewust voor gekozen het gebruik van de bestaande AvePoint-oplossing te continueren. Vervanging door een alternatieve oplossing zou aanzienlijke migratie-, implementatie-, configuratie-, test- en transitiewerkzaamheden met zich meebrengen. Daarnaast zou dit aanpassingen vereisen van bestaande beheerprocessen en werkwijzen en leiden tot aanzienlijke omstelkosten, implementatierisico's en risico's voor de continuïteit van de dienstverlening. UM is van oordeel dat deze gevolgen, mede gelet op het voorwerp en de omvang van deze opdracht, niet proportioneel zijn. Om deze redenen heeft deze aanbesteding specifiek betrekking op de levering van AvePoint Control Suite Plus for Microsoft 365 and Power Platform. Deze aanbesteding is derhalve niet bedoeld voor de selectie of implementatie van een alternatieve softwareoplossing. De verwijzing naar AvePoint betekent nadrukkelijk niet dat de opdracht is voorbehouden aan AvePoint als fabrikant. De gevraagde AvePoint-licenties kunnen door meerdere wederverkopers/partners worden aangeboden. Hierdoor is daadwerkelijke mededinging op het niveau van de leverancier/wederverkoper mogelijk. De looptijd van de overeenkomst is 2 jaar met de mogelijkheid tot verlenging van 2 maal 1 jaar (maximaal 4 jaar). Gedurende de looptijd kunnen de aantallen worden aangepast.

Dans le secteur dit « P47 », entre l’extrémité de la chambre Ofrou et le giratoire P47, une antenne de ce réseau est constituée de deux tuyaux parallèles (1 bras aller, 1 bras retour) de grand diamètre (diamètres intérieurs 700 mm). Les tubes ont été aboutés sur chantier par soudure. Ils ont été posés en fouille ouverte dans un site fortement contraint. Afin de renforcer ces conduites, SIG souhaite procéder à un chemisage structurant apte à reprendre une pression interne PN16.

description: Projekto konkurso pirkimo objektas: Alytaus miesto bibliotekos statybos techninio darbo projekto parengimo (projektinių pasiūlymų su statybą leidžiančiu dokumentu, techninio darbo projekto, projekto vykdymo priežiūros), taikant informacinį modeliavimą (BIM) paslaugos. Projekto konkurso uždaviniai, susiję su urbanistiniais, architektūriniais projektavimo aspektais yra šie: sukurti bibliotekos pastato modernius, integralius, architektūrinius, erdvinius planinius sprendinius, atliepiančius šiuolaikinės bibliotekos poreikius. title: Neubau Kita Schwalbennest - Elektroarbeiten
description: Die Gemeinde Schönefeld beabsichtigt die Kita Schwalbennest, Schwalbenweg 8, Schönefeld komplett neu zu errichten. Hier handelt es sich um die Elektroarbeiten. Im Zuge des Neubaus der KITA Schwalbennest wird die Elektroinstallation mit den Kostengruppen 440 und 450 ausgeschrieben. Die elektrische Energieversorgung erfolgt über einem neuen Hausanschluss der E.DIS Netz GmbH. Der Eektroenergiebedarf wird über eine Wandlermessung erfasst. Der neu zu errichtende Gebäude-Hauptverteiler(NSHV) versorgt dabei in dem zweigeschossigen Gebäude jeweils zwei Unterverteilungen pro Etage. Zur Senkung des Elektroenergiebedarfs ist eine PV-Anlage auf dem Flachdach vorgesehen. Im Gebäude ist eine Sicherheitsbeleuchtung der Flucht- und Rettungswege gemäß Brandschutzkonzept vorzusehen. Die Sicherheitsbeleuchtungsanlage wird gemäß DIN VDE 0108-100 und DIN EN 1838 ausgeführt. Die Sicherheitsbeleuchtung wird dabei über eine Einzellbatterieanlage realisiert. Die Erdungsanlage wird gemäß DIN 18014 hergestellt. Eine baurechtlich geforderte Blitzschutzanlage wird gemäß der Blitzschutzklasse III nach DIN VDE 0185-305 errichtet.

description: Weiterentwicklung und Realisierung eines Medien-, Veranstaltungs-, Büro-, Studio- und Mobilitätscluster ----------------------------------------------------------- Gegenstand des Vorhabens ist die Weiterentwicklung des Südteils des Funkhausareals in München am Rundfunkplatz zu einem Medien-, Veranstaltungs-, Büro-, Studio- und Mobilitätscluster durch einen im Vergabeverfahren auszuwählenden Projektpartner. Der BR bleibt im Südteil Grundstückseigentümer und soll dort als Leitnutzer und Impulsgeber sichtbar bleiben. Er erfüllt damit auch die Anforderungen aus der Gemeinbedarfsbindung des Bebauungsplans Nr. 937 der Landeshauptstadt München, in dessen Umgriff die zu entwickelnden bzw. zu überplanenden Grundstücke liegen. Das Vorhaben umfasst – nach Durchführung der vorgesehenen und zur Realisierung des Vorhabens auch erforderlichen Realteilung der derzeit ungeteilten Flächen – mehrere Grundstücke im Südteil des Hochhausareals. Grundlage für die räumliche Einordnung ist der im „kleinen“ Datenraum bereitgestellte vorläufige Realteilungsplan. Die endgültige Grundstücks-, Erbbaurechts-, Dienstbarkeits- und Schnittstellenstruktur wird im weiteren Verfahren auf Grundlage der freigegebenen Plan- und Vertragsunterlagen konkretisiert. Die Vorhabenbeschreibung sieht die Bestellung zweier Erbbaurechte auf noch real zu teilenden Flächen vor. Der spätere Erbbauberechtigte soll das unternehmerische Risiko der mit den Erbbaurechten verknüpften Verpflichtungen zu genehmigungsfähiger Planung, Bau, Sanierung, Vermietung, Betrieb, Bewirtschaf-tung, Instandhaltung, Finanzierung und Schnittstellensteuerung im vertraglich festgelegten Umfang tragen. Das Verfahren umfasst drei Auftragsbestandteile: • Auftragsbestandteil 1: Veranstaltungsbereich („Erbbaurecht 1“). • Auftragsbestandteil 2: Hochhaus („Erbbaurecht 2“). • Auftragsbestandteil 3: Tiefgarage (eigentums- bzw. erbbaurechtsübergreifend). --- Gegenstand des geplanten wettbewerblichen Dialogs ist keine isolierte Bau- oder Sanierungsleistung, sondern die vertragliche Strukturierung, Entwicklung, Finanzierung, bauliche Realisierung, Vermietung, Bewirtschaftung und Instandhaltung von drei eng miteinander verzahnten Teilprojekten. Der BR kann im Dialog auch Finanzierungsvarianten, Finanzierungsunterstützungen oder eine eigene Finanzierungskomponente prüfen, soweit dies vergaberechtlich zulässig, wirtschaftlich vorteilhaft und mit dem angestrebten Gesamtsystem vereinbar ist. Eine Finanzierungszusage des BR wird jedoch ausdrücklich nicht erteilt. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Die nähere Beschreibung der Maßnahme und die Bedingungen zur Teilnahme entnehmen Sie den Vergabeunterlagen, insbesondere den Dokumenten "BR_MMH_Vorhabenbeschreibung" und "BR_MMH_Bewerbungsbedingungen und Verfahrensbeschreibung". --- Darin ist auch die Aufwandsentschädigung für die Teilanahme an der Dialogphase umfassend geregelt.

title: ADVANCE PROCUREMENT NOTICE - RECAPITALIZE ANTI ARMOUR RANGE (MDB)
description: Advance Procurement Notice Recapitalize Anti Armour Range (MODIFIED DESIGN-BUILD) 5 CDSB Gagetown, Oromocto, NB. (with Security Requirements) Purpose of this Advance Procurement Notice This is not a bid solicitation nor a request for proposals. In the context of the major investments announced by the Government and to foster a proactive partnership with industry, DCC is issuing this Advance Procurement Notice (APN) to inform design-builders of an upcoming contract opportunity at 5 CDSB Gagetown, Oromocto, NB. The purpose of this APN is to allow design-builders to assess their capacity and interest in participating, and to prepare adequately for the potential solicitation process, notably by initiating any necessary steps. This is a preliminary notice regarding a potential contract, which includes security requirements. The purpose of this APN is to allow interested design-builders to initiate, if required, the sponsorship process to obtain the necessary clearances or security clearances (if applicable). Please note that this project may include Indigenous businesses participation component in accordance with the Procurement Strategy for Indigenous Business (PSIB). Please note that there is no guarantee that this contract will proceed or that security clearances will be granted within the anticipated timelines or at all as part of the sponsorship process. Description of the Project and Services It is anticipated that the following solicitation will proceed as noted in the table below. This is conditional on the contract receiving approval to proceed from DND. Contract Number: HQ04022_86689 Title: Recapitalize Anti Armour Range Approximate Estimate: $109M Anticipated Posting: November 2026 Description: The proposed recapitalization work includes: Upgrade Firing Point 6 (FP6) to serve as a replacement for Firing Point 4 (FP4), ensuring continued Level 5/6 training capability during construction. The FP6 recapitalization includes four new 2 km long firing lanes, crossing lanes for target access, protective berms, fire base pads, unexploded ordnance (UXO) clearance, vegetation management, arc markers, buried electrical conduits for target systems, a multi-storey control tower, and a climate-controlled sentry shack. Once FP6 is operational, FP4 will be upgraded with four recapitalized firing lanes, crossing lanes, protective berms, tank table positions, UXO clearance, vegetation management, arc markers, buried electrical conduits New approximately 455 m² climate-controlled administrative building, and refurbishment of the existing control tower. Contract Award and Anticipated Security Requirements To be eligible for contract award, a proponent will be required to, among other things, actively hold or obtain all required security clearance(s) prior to the date of the award, as further detailed in the solicitation documents. The anticipated security clearance level for this contract is Designated Organization Screening (DOS). Industrial Security Program Sponsorship Defence Construction Canada (DCC) is providing design-builders early access to the security clearance application process through sponsorship under its Industrial Security Program (ISP). Accordingly, design-builders that intend to submit a proposal for this project and that do not actively hold the above identified security clearance(s) should begin forthwith the security clearance application process by applying through DCC’s ISP. Under this program, DCC may, at its entire discretion, provide preliminary assistance to all the potential proponents with their respective security clearance sponsorship process. To begin the security clearance sponsorship process, please submit a sponsorship request application to DCC by following the steps identified on DCC’s website at: https://www.dcc-cdc.gc.ca/industry/security-requirements. In their sponsorship request application to DCC, design-builders are asked to quote the following information, among other things:   Advance Procurement Notice (APN) number (Project number on the MERX notice); Contract number 86689 CN; and Level of clearance requested to be sponsored for. Sponsorship Process Upon receipt, DCC will review the sponsorship request application and will communicate directly with the design-builders to provide assistance for the completion of the sponsorship request packages. Once DCC has determined, at its entire discretion, that a design-builder:   has started the sponsorship process prior to the solicitation (Contract number listed on their request for sponsorship) being advertised on MERX, has met all the material requirements of the sponsorship request package, and has submitted a proposal or a bid DCC will send the documents to the Public Services and Procurement Canada’s (PSPC) Contract Security Program (CSP). Following receipt of the sponsorship request package, the CSP will communicate directly with the proponent regarding any further steps or actions to be undertaken or the status of the sponsorship request package processing. At such time, the proponent will need to promptly cooperate with CSP to ensure that the process is completed as soon as possible. Questions Any questions pertaining to the sponsoring process through the ISP can be addressed to: Telephone Number: (613) 998-8974; or Email address: ISP.Sponsorship@dcc-cdc.gc.ca Any questions relating to this Advance Procurement Notice can be addressed to: Yuriy Klitynskyy Team Lead Contract Services Defence Construction Canada 506 – 471 – 3972   Yuriy.Klitynskyy@dcc-cdc.gc.ca Disclaimer DCC is only providing assistance, at its entire discretion, for the above stated sponsorship process and does not provide any representations or guarantees that a sponsorship request package or a security clearance application forwarded by DCC to the CSP will be successful or result in the granting of the requested security clearance(s) by the CSP. At all times, the processing of a sponsorship request package or a security clearance application is subject to the respective terms, conditions, and timelines of DCC’s ISP sponsorship process and the CSP security clearance granting process. By applying to either of the aforementioned processes, the proponent agrees to bear any fees and risks associated with: (i) the completeness or accuracy, or lack thereof, of its application or related documents submitted under or in connection with either said processes, and (ii) the timeliness, or lack thereof, of any processing or granting of security clearance(s) under or in connection with either said processes. title: Romania – Feasibility study, advisory service, analysis – Servicii de proiectare faza studiu de fezabilitate (S.F.), conform H.G. nr. 907/2016, pentru proiectul de investiţie imobiliară: „Bază integrată de instruire pentru forțele cu destinație specială din Armata României în cazarma 3645 Mihai Bravu”, cod proiect 2025-I-3645
description: Serviciile care fac obiectul contractului sunt: – Studiu de Fezabilitate pentru obiectivul „Bază integrată de instruire pentru forţele cu destinaţie specială din Armata României în cazarma 3645 Mihai Bravu", conform H.G. nr. 907/2016, cu modificările şi completările ulterioare, în conformitate cu tema de proiectare; – Nota de prezentare, elaborată conform conţinutului-cadru prevăzut în Anexa nr. 4 a Regulamentului privind organizarea şi funcţionarea Consiliului tehnico-economic al Ministerului Apărării Naţionale, aprobat prin Ordinul M.94/2017; – Studiu topografic în sistem STEREO 70; – Studiu geotehnic, verificat de verificator de proiecte atestat Af; – Studiu hidrogeologic; – Studiu balistic, necesar pentru fundamentarea soluţiilor de amenajare şi de siguranţă aferente obiectelor de instrucţie cu tragere (poligoane de tragere, shooting house, poligoane de antrenament), inclusiv stabilirea zonelor de siguranţă şi a soluţiilor de captare/oprire a proiectilelor; – Studiu de obstacolare şi documentaţia aferentă obţinerii avizului Autorităţii Aeronautice Civile Române (A.A.C.R.), necesar în raport cu heliportul prevăzut în cadrul obiectivului şi cu servituţile aeronautice aplicabile amplasamentului; – Studiu de circulaţie, necesar pentru fundamentarea soluţiilor de acces, a drumurilor şi platformelor interioare şi a legăturii cu reţeaua de drumuri existentă; – Studiu de soluţie şi de coexistenţă, necesar pentru racordarea la reţelele de utilităţi şi pentru stabilirea condiţiilor de coexistenţă cu reţelele şi obiectivele existente în zonă; – Raport de conformare NZEB, întocmit de auditor energetic pentru clădiri atestat; – Elaborarea documentaţiilor pentru obţinerea avizelor şi acordurilor solicitate prin Certificatul de Urbanism, precum şi asistenţă acordată Autorităţii contractante în vederea obţinerii avizelor, inclusiv Documentaţia pentru obţinerea acordului de principiu de securitate la incendiu şi documentaţia pentru obţinerea avizului privind sănătatea populaţiei. Totodată, Prestatorul va asigura suport de specialitate Autorităţii contractante la prezentarea documentaţiei tehnico-economice în vederea obţinerii avizului C.T.E. al M.Ap.N. (prezentare în format .pptx sau similar pentru susţinerea documentaţiei întocmite în vederea avizării şi aprobării în şedinţa Consiliului Tehnico-Economic al Ministerului Apărării Naţionale). De asemenea, la solicitarea Autorităţii contractante, Prestatorul acordă asistenţă tehnică de specialitate şi transmite clarificări cu privire la documentaţia tehnico-economică elaborată de acesta, pe durata promovării fazelor următoare ale proiectului (elaborare D.T.A.C., P.Th. + D.E., execuţie lucrări). Clarificările se transmit exclusiv Autorităţii contractante, care le valorifică potrivit competenţelor proprii. Prestatorul nu participă la derularea procedurilor de atribuire subsecvente şi nu are acces la ofertele depuse ori la identitatea operatorilor economici participanţi. Numărul de zile până la care se pot solicita clarificări înainte de data limita de depunere a ofertelor/candidaturilor: 12. AC va răspunde în mod clar și complet la toate solicitările de clarificări în conformitate cu prevederile art. 69 și 70 din O.U.G. 114/2011 cu modificările și completările ulterioare, dar nu mai târziu de 6 zile înainte de data-limită stabilită pentru depunerea ofertelor.

title: Cloth, Coated, Nylon/Polyurethane, 235 g/m², CADPAT™ Multi-Terrain (MT) – Re-Tender
description: The Department of National Defence (DND), has a requirement for the production and supply of CADPAT-patterned clothing and associated items for the Canadian Armed Forces (CAF). This solicitation is subject to limited tendering. Only companies holding a valid and active licence to print CADPAT, issued by the Department of National Defence, will be invited to submit bids. The following licensed companies are eligible to participate in this solicitation: • Textiles Monterey (1996) Inc. / Monterey Textiles (1996) Inc. • Brookwood Companies Incorporated • Textil Santanderina, S.A. • NV Utexbel • Brittany Global Technologies Corporation Where a supplier has previously submitted samples to DND for the same or equivalent requirement, those samples may be retained and considered for use in support of the upcoming solicitation, subject to confirmation by DND that they remain representative of the proposed product and continue to meet the applicable technical requirements. Companies interested in obtaining a CADPAT printing licence are invited to contact: Requesting the Commercial Use of the Canadian Disruptive Pattern (CADPAT) - Canada.ca for information regarding the licensing process and eligibility requirements. By limiting the solicitation to organizations that currently hold a valid CADPAT printing licence, DND can ensure compliance with intellectual property, security, and technical requirements associated with the production of CADPAT-patterned materials. Request for Standing Offers (RFSO) package would be provided directly to the eligible licensed firms, increasing the likelihood of receiving compliant and competitive bids. At the same time, transparency is maintained by clearly identifying the eligibility requirements, listing the licensed companies eligible to participate, and providing information for other interested firms wishing to pursue a CADPAT printing licence for future opportunities.

title: APN-AEC11 SOURCE CONTROL (DESIGN BID BUILD) 19 WING, CFB COMOX, LAZO, BC
description: ADVANCE PROCUREMENT NOTICE AEC11 Source control (design bid build) 19 wing, CFB Comox, Lazo, BC (with security requirements) 1. PURPOSE OF THIS ADVANCE PROCUREMENT NOTICE This is not a bid solicitation nor a request for proposals. In the context of the major investments announced by the Government and to foster a proactive partnership with industry, DCC is issuing this Advance Procurement Notice (APN) to inform contractors of an upcoming contract opportunity at 19 Wing, CFB Comox, Lazo, BC. The purpose of this APN is to allow contractors to assess their capacity and interest in participating, and to prepare adequately for the potential solicitation process. This is a preliminary notice regarding a potential contract, which includes security requirements. The purpose of this APN is to allow interested contractors to initiate, if required, the sponsorship process to obtain the necessary clearances or security clearances (if applicable). Please note that there is no guarantee that this contract will proceed or that security clearances will be granted within the anticipated timelines or at all as part of the sponsorship process. Please note that this project may include Indigenous businesses participation component in accordance with the Procurement Strategy for Indigenous Business (PSIB). 2. DESCRIPTION OF THE PROJECT AND SERVICES It is anticipated that the following solicitation will proceed as noted in the table below. This is conditional on the contract receiving approval to proceed from DND. APN or Contract Number: 87758 Approximate Estimate: $9,300,000 Anticipated Posting: January 2027 Description: Remediation of PFAS-impacted soils at CFB Comox through in-situ soil mixing (chemical) and stabilization, selective excavation, off-site disposal, drainage improvements, and site restoration. The work is located within a former detonation and training area and is subject to UXO risk, environmental protection requirements, and tight seasonal construction windows. Construction will be completed in two distinct phases due to schedule constraints, UXO sequencing, and constructability considerations. 3. CONTRACT AWARD AND ANTICIPATED SECURITY REQUIREMENTS To be eligible for contract award, a proponent will be required to, among other things, actively hold or obtain all required security clearance(s) prior to the date of the award, as further detailed in the solicitation documents. The anticipated security clearance level for this contract is Designated Organization Screening (DOS). 4. Industrial Security Program Sponsorship Defence Construction Canada (DCC) is providing contractors early access to the security clearance application process through sponsorship under its Industrial Security Program (ISP). Accordingly, contractors that intend to submit a proposal for this project and that do not actively hold the above identified security clearance(s) should begin forthwith the security clearance application process by applying through DCC’s ISP. Under this program, DCC may, at its entire discretion, provide preliminary assistance to all the potential proponents with their respective security clearance sponsorship process. To begin the security clearance sponsorship process, please submit a sponsorship request application to DCC by following the steps identified on DCC’s website at: https://www.dcc-cdc.gc.ca/industry/security-requirements. In their sponsorship request application to DCC, contractors are asked to quote the following information, among other things: Advance Procurement Notice (APN) number, as identified in Section 2 of this APN; and Level of clearance requested to be sponsored, as identified in Section 3 of this APN. 5. Sponsorship Process Upon receipt, DCC will review the sponsorship request application and will communicate directly with the contractors to provide assistance for the completion of the sponsorship request packages. Once DCC has determined, at its entire discretion, that a contractor: has started the sponsorship process prior to the solicitation being advertised on MERX, has met all the material requirements of the sponsorship request package prior to the closing date indicated in the solicitation, and has submitted a proposal.   DCC will send the documents to the Public Services and Procurement Canada’s (PSPC) Contract Security Program (CSP). Note – Contractors that do not submit a proposal will not be able to attain clearance through this sponsorship process. Following receipt of the sponsorship request package, the CSP will communicate directly with the proponent or tenderer regarding any further steps or actions to be undertaken or the status of the sponsorship request package processing. At such time, the proponent will need to promptly cooperate with CSP to ensure that the process is completed as soon as possible. 6. Questions Any questions pertaining to the sponsoring process through the ISP can be addressed to: Telephone Number: (613) 998-8974; or Email address: ISP.Sponsorship@dcc-cdc.gc.ca Any questions relating to this Advance Procurement Notice can be addressed to: Sarah Kinnon Coordinator, Contract Services Defence Construction Canada (236) 255-1745 Sarah.kinnon@dcc-cdc.gc.ca 7. Disclaimer DCC is only providing assistance, at its entire discretion, for the above stated sponsorship process  and does not provide any representations  or guarantees that a sponsorship request package or a security clearance application forwarded by DCC to the CSP will be successful or result in the granting of the requested security clearance(s) by the CSP. At all times, the processing of a sponsorship request package or a security clearance application is subject to the respective terms, conditions, and timelines of DCC’s ISP sponsorship process and the CSP security clearance granting process. By applying to either of the aforementioned processes, the proponent agrees to bear any fees and risks associated with: (i) the completeness or accuracy, or lack thereof, of its application or related documents submitted under or in connection with either said processes, and (ii) the timeliness, or lack thereof, of any processing or granting of security clearance(s) under or in connection with either said processes. Notwithstanding anything else stated above, DCC shall in no event be liable to the proponent for any direct, indirect, incidental, special, consequential, punitive or exemplary damages arising out or in connection with the above stated sBidding and Documents are available on http://www.merx.com. Fees may apply; See https://www.merx.com/public/pricing for more information.

title: AFP for Lease of Discovery Park at Michoud Assembly Facility
description: This Announcement for Proposals (AFP) solicits proposals for lease of Discovery Park which represents a selection of available real property assets at MAF. The real property assets (The Property) known as Discovery Park, and shown in Exhibit A, are as follows: 1. Approximately 45 Acres of Greenspace: This tract of land lies on the northern extent of the facility and is bounded by Old Gentilly Road (publicly accessible roadway) as well as Mercury, Uranus and Venus Drives, which are interior to the security fencing. The acreage is currently classified as underutilized greenspace. The tract�s frontage to Old Gentilly Road has availability to direct connection with municipal power, potable water and sewer services. These utilities may be established with each respective service carrier. Please see Exhibit B for a listing of municipal resources which may assist in performing diligence for these service agreements. The acreage includes what were previously large sections of parking areas that supported a previously demolished building. These areas are past their useful service life and thus have been considered greenspace for appraisal purposes. 2. Building 351: Building 351 is an approximately 32,000 sf mixed used facility. The building is subdivided into two main areas: formal event space and cafeteria. The building currently is connected to the MAF utility grids. As a result, some determination will need to be made with respect to severing the building from those utilities and re-establishing utility services from the previously mentioned municipal service providers based upon the proposer�s concept of use. This reconfiguration would be made subject to NASA�s approval and terms of use. The Proposer may choose to propose on either asset separately or a combination of the two. NASA shall have the authority to execute either one or multiple leases in the event The Proposer chooses to include a combination of both assets in their submission. NASA intends to utilize Enhanced Use Lease authority as set forth in 51 U.S.C. 20145 as the sole means to enter into a lease(s) for The Property. The Proposer will assume any and all financial responsibilities for operations and maintenance of The Property under such a lease. The terms and conditions in the attached Model Enhanced Use Lease (EUL) generally demonstrate all the Proposer responsibilities including those maintenance and operational parameters. While The Property has existing utilities which serve other portions of the facility, the Proposer should not assume that any existing utilities will be available for use and that any utilities required for development will be at the sole cost of the Proposer. The Property will be available at award in �as is� condition for no less than one ten (10) year base term. title: Prestations de communication dans le domaine de la protection du climat
description:
Le marché porte sur des prestations de communication visant à sensibiliser et à mobiliser différents publics cibles dans le domaine de la protection du climat pour le service de l’environnement et de la santé de la Ville de Zurich (UGZ). Les prestations comprennent l’élaboration de stratégies et de concepts ainsi que la planification et la mise en œuvre de campagnes, d’actions et de mesures de communication connexes.

Un contrat-cadre d’une durée de deux ans sera conclu avec l’agence de communication retenue, avec une option de prolongation d’une durée totale de deux années supplémentaires.

description: In het TSG zal het Zorginstituut, in samenwerking met betrokken partijen, voor elk nieuw geneesmiddel op basis van een risicoduiding bekijken of een beoordeling nodig is, wat voor beoordeling dat moet zijn en wie deze uitvoert. Deze samenwerking moet ondersteund worden met behulp van een informatiemanagementsysteem (IMS). Door informatie op één plek te verzamelen waar de verschillende partijen toegang tot hebben, kan het risicogericht werken worden uitgevoerd en wordt communicatie hierover ondersteund, zoals beschreven in het TSG. De informatie voor het risicogericht werken wordt verzameld vanuit de Horizonscan en mogelijk andere bronnen. In eerste instantie moet het IMS het nieuwe instroomproces volgens TSG praktisch uitvoerbaar maken, deze wetgeving gaat in per 1 januari 2028. In de doorontwikkelfase kan verdere ondersteuning van de huidige situatie van het geneesmiddelbeoordelingsproces (organisatorische, procesmatige, gegevens en functionele context) evenals nog uit te werken elementen, in het IMS.

description: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), Detroit District is seeking contractor with the capability to provide construction services for Maintenance Dredging for South Haven Harbor and New Buffalo Harbor. The project includes mobilize to dredge of both New Buffalo Harbor, located in Berrien County, Michigan and South Haven Habor, located in Van Buren County, Michigan. De-mobilize when dredging is completed. NO SOLICITATION, SPECIFICATION OR DRAWING are available for this Notice. The Government intends to solicit this opportunity as an Invitation for Bid (IFB). The IFB is intended to be issued as a 100% Small Business Set Aside, and the Government intends to award to the lowest priced bid that is determined to be responsible. The North American Industrial Classification System (NAICS) code for this work is 237990, Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction, which has a small business size standard of $37.0 million in average annual receipts with the Dredging and Surface Cleanup Activities exception. General Information The Government intends to issue a Firm-Fixed Price (FFP) Construction Contract. The estimated anticipated Solicitation Posting Date: April 7, 2026 The estimated anticipated Bid Due Date: May 7, 2026 The estimated magnitude of construction is between $500,000 and $1,000,000. The Product Service Code is Y1KF ? Construction of Dredging Facilities. The solicitation package materials, documents, drawings, specifications, and attachments to the anticipated solicitation will be available only electronically and via the System for Award Management (SAM). Contractors can access SAM free of charge at www.sam.gov. The solicitation posted on SAM.gov will include a link to all solicitation documents which will be stored in the Solicitation module of the Procurement Integrated enterprise Environment (PIEE) system. Contractors may register for PIEE free of charge at https://piee.eb.mil/. In order for interest contractors to conduct business with the Federal Government, contractors must be registered in PIEE prior to the bid due date and in SAM.gov prior to any award. Hard copy documents will NOT be supplied by the Government to any interested parties as a result of this Pre-Solicitation Notice or the upcoming Solicitation. Electronic bid submission will be required through the PIEE Solicitation Module suite at https://piee.eb.mil. Please note the Government will not be maintaining a bidder list during the solicitation period. However, vendors are strongly encouraged to review the ?Interest Vendor List? found on sam.gov for this requirement.

title: USCG REGIONAL MULTIPLE AWARD CONSTRUCTION CONTRACT (RMACC III) Vendor Outreach Matchmaking Event (VOME)
description: REGISTRATION IS NOW OPEN! USCG REGIONAL MULTIPLE AWARD CONSTRUCTION CONTRACT (NMACC III) VENDOR OUTREACH MATCHMAKING EVENT (VOME) On Wednesday, September 10, 2025, from 9:00 a.m. � 4:00 p.m. ET, the U.S. Department of Homeland Security (DHS) Office of Small and Disadvantaged Business Utilization (OSDBU) in collaboration with the U.S. Coast Guard (USCG) will host a Vendor Outreach Matchmaking Event (VOME) for the third generation of the Regional Multiple Award Construction Indefinite Delivery Indefinite Quantity Contracts (RMACC III). This event will focus on matchmaking for small and other than small businesses that provide construction, architectural and engineering, and construction related services. Registration is be limited to those firms interested in the USCG RMACC III requirement as either a prime or subcontractor for any of the regions are encouraged to register for this event. Prior to registering, firms should review the active RMACC III Opportunity ID 70Z08725RRMACC003 and the published artifacts from the Virtual Industry Day (see links below). The table below reflects the planned set-aside by each region: Formerly July 2025 Name Change Planned Set-Aside District 1 USCG Northeast Region 8(a) District 5 USCG East Region SDVOSB District 7 USCG Southeast Region 8(a) District 7.5 USCG Southeast Region - Puerto Rico, US Virgin Islands 100% SB District 8 USCG Heartland Region Total/100% SB District 9 USCG Great Lakes Region HUBZone District 11 USCG Southwest Region 8(a) District 13 USCG Northwest Region SDVOSB District 14 USCG Oceania Region 8(a) District 17 USCG Arctic Region HUBZone; 8(a) The RMACC III VOME will be held virtually to connect businesses in a variety of ways, which includes the discussion of potential subcontracting opportunities; forming joint-venture or teaming partnerships; and facilitating discussions that may lead to mentor-prot�g� relationships. This event provides a virtual space where both large and small businesses can present their core capabilities. Each meeting will be 15 minutes established by matching of core competencies and lines of businesses as identified by each firms North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Code(s). Those small businesses that are primarily engaged in supplies/services under the following NAICS Sector and Subsectors should attend this event: 23 Construction 236 Construction of Buildings 237 Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction 238 Specialty Trade Contractors 532 Rental and Leasing Services (specifically, those relating to construction equipment rental and leasing services) 541 Professional, Scientific and Technical Services (specifically, those relating to architectural and engineering services) 562 Waste Management and Remediation Services (specifically, those relating to environmental remediation services) Registration is now open for the RMACC III VOME until 11:59 PM EDT, Monday, September 8, 2025. All firms can begin to request meetings on Monday, August 25, 2025. The delay between registration and the date to request meetings is to allow for a robust database of participating firms. We encourage businesses to upload their capability statements when registering for the RMACC III VOME. Each registrant will request to meet with other businesses that align with services or products they provide or are seeking. Registration does not guarantee a meeting and each business will decide which requests meet their needs by acceptance of the meeting request(s). What This Event Is: � Virtual one-on-one 15-minute meeting(s) between two (large to small or small to small) businesses. � An opportunity to present capabilities and to have potential discussions outside of the VOME. � An opportunity for small businesses to establish a relationship with large or other small businesses currently doing business with DHS or other federal agencies and/or actively seeking opportunities. What This Event Is NOT: � A virtual Vendor Outreach Session. There are no meetings with DHS Small Business Specialists. � A webinar event or training. All small and large businesses are required to register at https://mbmapp.com/event/rmaccvome2025 and provide the required information including a capability statement and a valid point of contact email address in their profile compatible with various virtual meeting tools (e.g., Zoom, Microsoft Teams, WebEx, etc.). Once your firm receives confirmation of a meeting from the scheduling site, you will receive a follow-up email with the virtual meeting invitation. If you do not see a meeting invitation, check your spam or junk mail folders. A platform tutorial is also being provided in this notice outlining the registration and meeting process. Please be advised that if connectivity issues occur using the virtual tools, the session may be conducted telephonically or rescheduled. Questions on the RMACC III VOME should be sent to OSDBU.VOS@hq.dhs.gov.

description: Le projet de contournement de la ville du Locle est un nouvel aménagement et consiste en un évitement en tunnel par le Nord (un tube bidirectionnel avec galerie de sécurité), qui débute vers la gare du Col des Roches (site de la carrière des Granges) pour aboutir à la jonction existante du Crêt-du-Locle. title: Switzerland – Technical services – Zukunft Bahnhof Bern, Bausteine 1,2,4, 3a, 3b, Umweltbaubegleitung: 3'000 h externe Projektleitung
description: Mit dieser Ausschreibung wird das Mandat «Umweltbaubegleitung» im Rahmen eines öffentlichen Verfahrens ausgeschrieben. Die Umweltbaubegleitung (UBB) begleitet und überwacht die Umweltbelange beim Bau und unterstützt die Bauherrschaft in der rechtskonformen Realisierung des Bauvorhabens. Dabei achtet Sie auf die Einhaltung der umweltrelevanten Gesetze, Verordnungen, Richtlinien, Wegleitungen und Auflagen. Die UBB berät und unterstützt die Beteiligten, beobachtet und beurteilt Umweltprobleme auf der Baustelle und stellt die Umsetzung der Umweltauflagen und Bedingungen aus dem Bewilligungsverfahren sicher. Die UBB berät die Bauherrschaft zudem zu Fragen im Bereich Umwelt. Die UBB aktualisiert regelmässig die Vollzugs- und Auflagenkontrolle (VAK) der Umweltauflagen (s. auch Anhang 03: Auflagen Gesamtbauentscheid zu ÜO ZBBS vom 30.10.2025) und dokumentiert diese in geeigneter Weise (Liste, Datenbank o.ä.). Die UBB führt zudem den Nachweis/Dokumentation über die Erfüllung der Umweltauflagen zuhanden der Behörden und führt eine Pendenzenliste, in welcher die umweltrelevanten Pendenzen aufgeführt sind. Die Pendenzenliste ist, wenn möglich in die Pendenzenliste der Bausitzung zu integrieren. Die UBB überwacht sämtliche Projektbelange und -abläufe mit umweltrelevanten Auswirkungen im Sinne des Vorsorgeprinzips auf die Einhaltung der Umweltvorschriften. Dazu gehören die Ausschreibungen, die Bauplanung, die Planung und Einrichtung der Bauinstallationsplätze, die Transportrouten und -wege, die Materialflüsse, die Bauausführung sowie die Umsetzung der Schutz- und Rekultivierungsmassnahmen. Die UBB ist integral zuständig für sämtliche umweltrelevanten Aspekte, die bei der Realisierung des Vorhabens eine Rolle spielen, die bodenkundliche Baubegleitung (sofern notwendig) inbegriffen. Die UBB stellt primär die sachgerechte Umsetzung der Umweltauflagen aus dem Bewilligungsverfahren sicher und hilft, die Einhaltung der umweltrelevanten Gesetze, Verordnungen, Richtlinien und Wegleitungen zu gewährleisten. Bei der Umsetzung der Umweltauflagen ist der Wortlaut der Bewilligung massgebend. Während der Bauausführung überwacht sie die fachgerechte Umsetzung der im Bewilligungsverfahren, Leistungsverzeichnis und Werkvertrag festgelegten Umweltschutzmassnahmen und überprüft deren Wirkung. Das vorliegende Pflichtenheft basiert auf den bekannten Grundlagen zum Zeitpunkt der Erarbeitung. Sämtliche zum Zeitpunkt der Erarbeitung noch unbekannten Umweltauflagen müssen durch die Auftragnehmerin ebenfalls erfüllt bzw. geprüft werden. Sofern dies nachweislich zu Zusatzleistungen bei der Auftragnehmerin führt, werden diese vergütet und sind durch die Auftragnehmerin zu den Konditionen des Grundauftrags zu erledigen. title: Ganzheitliche Unterstützung bei der Messung, Qualitätssicherung, Auswertung und wissenschaftlichen Einordnung klimawirksamer halogenierter Spurengase an der GAW-Station Zugspitze unter Verwendung eines MEDUSA-Systems im AGAGE-Kontext
description: Ziel des Projektes ist die fachliche Unterstützung des Umweltbundesamtes bei der Einrichtung, Inbetriebnahme, dem Anlaufbetrieb sowie der wissenschaftlich-technischen Etablierung eines MEDUSA-Messsystems zur kontinuierlichen Bestimmung langlebiger klimawirksamer halogenierter Spurengase (insbesondere FCKW) an der GAW-Station Zugspitze. . Der Auftragnehmende erbringt seine Leistungen unterstützend und begleitend in enger Abstimmung mit dem Auftraggeber. Die Verantwortung für den Messbetrieb verbleibt beim Umweltbundesamt. Der Auftragnehmende übernimmt insbesondere unterstützende Tätigkeiten in folgenden Bereichen: - Unterstützung bei der Installation und Inbetriebnahme des MEDUSA-Systems - Unterstützung bei der Konfiguration der Hard- und Software einschließlich der Aus-wertesoftware GCWerks gemäß AGAGE-Standards - Unterstützung bei der Bereitstellung und Implementierung geeigneter Kalibrier- und Referenzstandards für den kontinuierlichen Messbetrieb - fachliche Begleitung der Anlaufphase - Unterstützung bei der wissenschaftlichen Auswertung und Einordnung der quali-tätsgesicherten Messdaten. . Ziel ist es, gemeinsam mit dem Auftraggeber einen stabilen, qualitätsgesicherten und AGAGE-kompatiblen Betrieb des MEDUSA-Systems an der GAW-Station Zugspitze zu etablieren und zugleich einen nachhaltigen Kompetenzaufbau beim Stationspersonal zu gewährleisten.

title: Forschungsprojekt - DZSF - Bedingungen für die Inbetriebnahme fahrerloser Straßenbahnen
description: Ziel des Projekts ist es, einen Handlungsrahmen für die Inbetriebnahmegenehmigung fahrerloser Straßenbahnen zu schaffen, ohne die Notwendigkeit von Ausnahmegenehmigungen im Einzelfall durch den gesonderten Nachweis gleicher Sicherheit. Hierfür soll untersucht werden, welche technisch-funktionalen, sicherheitsbezogenen und betrieblichen Vorgaben für die Inbetriebnahme des Gesamtsystems Straßenbahn oder einzelner Systemkomponenten geregelt werden und auf welcher regulatorischen Ebene diese verankert sein sollten.

description: Please find attached a Request for Proposal (RFP) concerning an upcoming acquisition for Scaffolding Services in support of the Long-Baseline Neutrino Facility (LBNF) project.
